title: MDS token extension
description: Shape of $extensions.mds on every token in tokens/*.tokens.json. The rest of each token follows the W3C DTCG format ($type, $value, $description, $deprecated). Written by scripts/build-tokens.mjs (ADR 003).

tier.x-source: the file the token is in

component.description: Component name. Required when tier is component.

source.description: Where the token is defined in the Magenta repo, e.g. packages/css/src/tokens.ts.

cssVar.description: The CSS variable Panda emits. Null when there is none: breakpoints are Panda conditions, text styles are applied by the Text recipe.

write.description: How to reference the token in code.

panda.description: Value or key in a Panda style object, e.g. 'neutral.900' for color: or textStyle: 'body1'.

css.description: Value in plain CSS, e.g. var(--mag-colors-neutral-900).

px.description: Dimension tokens: the value in px, with 1rem = 16px.

codeValue.description: The value exactly as the code writes it, when $value had to be converted to fit DTCG (e.g. 'transparent', 'none').

status.description: forbidden: a foundation note says MUST NOT use it. The code still has it.

forbiddenBy.description: The note that forbids the token.

roles.description: What the token is for. One entry per row of a Semantic roles table that names it (ADR 001).

descriptionSource.description: Who wrote $description and roles: team (the note is approved) or ai-draft (nobody has checked it yet).

contrast.description: Color tokens: WCAG contrast ratio against each Use on background, truncated to two decimals.

text.description: Text styles: which Text level and size this is, and the viewports where responsive text uses it.

responsiveDiffers.description: Values responsive text gets at this size when they differ from size={size}.

figma.description: Where the token lives in the Figma library. The Figma variable is generated from this token (ADR 003).

variable.description: Variable name, the code path joined by '/'. Null when the token is not a Figma variable.

style.description: Name of the paint, text or effect style that uses the token.

modes.description: Value per non-default mode, e.g. dark. The default mode is $value. Magenta has no modes yet.

replacedBy.description: Token path that replaces this one. Required when $deprecated is set.
replacedBy.x-source: Semantic roles table, column Replaced by
